SELECT 
  tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as active_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE valid_from <= '2024-12-22' AND valid_to >= '2024-12-22'
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as count
FROM dim_member
WHERE valid_from <= '2024-12-22' AND valid_to >= '2024-12-22'
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY CASE WHEN tier IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tier
